summary: The bounded dual-authority rule is directionally correct, but caller-owned mutable containers allow one RunIntent to produce changing V2 hashes; V2 canonicalization is not guaranteed at construction; and the design overstates the currently landed caller and verification surface.

limitations: Read-only review; no production, design or ledger edits.
No replay, fit, PIT, real-data access, CCC or Gate execution.

blockers: Take and validate an owned immutable V2 canonical snapshot at construction while preserving V1 byte identity.
Specify V2-only recursive JSON/NFC validation and reject invalid binding content before side effects.
Describe the current state as a RunIntent-class-only partial slice until caller and verification obligations land.
